pin_title: 6 Halloween Party Food & Treat Buys Under £20 for a Spooky UK Spread
pin_title_alt: Last-Minute Halloween Dessert Table Ideas for Friday Night
pin_hook: Stands, sweets and spooky touches for the 31st
pin_description: Halloween party food ideas under £20 for a spooky spread at home: a 3-tier cake stand, fun size chocolate for trick-or-treaters, a cupcake tower, edible candy eyes for monster bakes, skull ice cubes and black food colouring. Easy Halloween treat table and party snack ideas UK hosts rate highly. #ad #halloweenparty #halloweentreats #halloweenbaking #ukdeals
intro: Halloween is this Friday, so here are six well-rated bits to turn your snacks and bakes into a proper spooky spread. Everything is under £20 and easy to pull together this week.

products.name: Nyxi 3 Tier Glass Cake Stand
products.headline: Turn a pile of bakes into a showpiece
products.why: An embossed glass three-tier stand that makes ghost cupcakes and brownies look like a proper dessert table, then carries on for Christmas and birthdays.

products.name: Mars Mixed Fun Size Chocolate Party Bag (71 bars)
products.headline: Trick-or-treat bowl sorted in one go
products.why: A big bag of Mars, Snickers, Twix, Bounty and Milky Way fun size bars, so you can fill the door bowl and still have some for the party.

products.name: BACUTHY 3 Tier Cupcake Stand
products.headline: Stack spooky cupcakes without crowding the table
products.why: A lightweight tiered stand that holds a batch of cupcakes or doughnuts upright, easy to wipe down and store flat afterwards.

products.name: Twisweet Candy Eyes 130g
products.headline: Instant monster faces on any bake
products.why: Pop these edible eyeballs on cupcakes, cookies or ghost meringues and plain bakes suddenly look Halloween-ready; a fun job to hand to the kids.

products.name: Halloween 10 Skulls Silicone Ice Cube Tray with Lid
products.headline: Spooky drinks with zero extra effort
products.why: Makes ten little skull ice cubes at a time, so punch, juice or cocktails look the part; the lid stops freezer smells getting in.

products.name: Sugarflair Black Extra Food Colouring Paste 42g
products.headline: Get a true black icing, not grey
products.why: A concentrated paste that bakers rely on for deep black buttercream and fondant, ideal for bats, cats and spider-web cupcakes.
